fixed_management.notes: CAVEAT: not from the manager or Maya. The manager's page gives only the fund's name and TASE number and links its details and prospectus to Maya (maya.tase.co.il/fund/5138763) and Magna (magna.isa.gov.il details.aspx), which return a JavaScript shell and HTTP 403 to scripts; needs a person in a browser. The figure here is the 'דמי ניהול קרן' Leumi prints for this fund on its Directive 447A money-market products page, which states 'המידע המוצג הוא בהתאם לדיווח שבוצע על ידי מנהלי הקרנות' and, for daily funds, 'בפרסום מוצגים דמי הניהול הנגבים על ידי מנהלי הקרנות'. Whether it includes the trustee fee is not stated (read as the manager's fee only). The page's as-of date is filled by script ('{asOfDate}') and was not visible, so effective_from is unknown. Exempt tax track: TXS-24 (Maya export of 2026-10-22) names the only two taxable money-market funds (5103403, 5137559); this fund is not one of them.
